payload.note: Independent tensor-phase hierarchy obstruction: for Omega(x)=product_(a=1)^k u(x_a), 2<=k<=4, exact expansion gives r=sum_a rho_a and g=sum_a h_a+sum_(a!=b) delta_a*rho_b. On a macroscopic increasing-ramp block, rho>0 while delta<0 and h<=-1/(8m^2), so every cross term reinforces. Hence Q_k>=1/(256*40^k*m^6) on L=4m^4+2 and Q_k/omega_L^2>=m^10/(16*40^k*pi^4)->infinity. This rules out independent multiplicative tensor copies of the cycle hierarchy only; genuinely coupled nonseparable correctors, the all-field torus bound, Witten/H^-1, continuum, Born/Krein and Lorentzian gates remain open.
